title: Shared users
cardDesc: Shared by WebDAV, FTP and SMB and managed on the File shared users page
usersDesc: Saving applies to WebDAV, FTP and SMB at once
off: Shared users cannot sign in to this service
help: Shared users have a password and directories just like the local users of each service and are kept in one place. When a service has a local user with the same name, only the local user is checked in that service (case-insensitive for SMB). SMB needs plain passwords, user and directory names cannot contain characters such as " / \ [ ] : ; {'|'} = , + * ? < >, and with several directories each directory name is the SMB share name.
loadError: The shared user configuration is invalid and shared users cannot sign in; fix it and save to restore them: {error}
shadowed: Same name as a local user, the local user is checked: {names}

issue.name: {name}: the user name cannot be used for SMB
issue.bcrypt: {name}: the password is a bcrypt hash; SMB needs the plain password, please set it again
issue.share: {name}: a directory name cannot be used as an SMB share name or is duplicated

page.title: File shared users
page.desc: Users shared by WebDAV, FTP and SMB, managed in one place

services.title: Services
services.desc: Whether shared users may sign in is set on each service page
services.none: The WebDAV, FTP and SMB modules are all turned off

selfService.title: Self-service password change
selfService.help: When on, shared file users can change their own password at {path} on any web service site with web authentication, after entering the current password; WebDAV, FTP and SMB use the new password right away. Plaintext passwords stay plaintext and bcrypt hashes stay hashed
